turns.text: Put our top 50 SKUs up 4%. What's it worth, and how much volume can we lose and still keep gross profit?

csvChecks.ask: price_rise.csv with columns metric,value and four rows: revenue_gbp, gross_profit_gbp, uplift_gbp and breakeven_volume_loss_pct (in %), for the 50 products with a cost that had the most 2011 net revenue, at 2011 volumes and costs
